name: io.github.userdefault13/cron402-mcp
title: cron402
description: Schedule webhook calls, pay per run in USDC on Base via x402. Ten tools, built for small models.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet private key (0x…). Fund with USDC on Base mainnet or Sepolia. Without it the server starts read-only: the free tools still work.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id. Default eip155:8453 (Base mainnet); use eip155:84532 for Sepolia.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: cron402 API base URL. Defaults to the production Worker.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where created job ids are remembered so list_crons can recover them. Defaults to ~/.cron402.
